snippet.title: Pixel Wheels gets a soundtrack!
snippet.description:
Just integrated free musics from the talented FoxSynergy in Pixel Wheels.


- Menu: Grey Sector v0.86 - https://opengameart.org/content/grey-sector-8-bit
- Country Life championship: Cosmo Blast v1.0 - https://opengameart.org/content/cosmo-blast
- Pix Cities championship: Bouncing Baal v0.95 - https://opengameart.org/content/bouncing-baal
- Square Mountains championship: Lunar Harvest v1.0 - https://opengameart.org/content/lunar-harvest
- Victory: Core Descent (16-bit) https://opengameart.org/content/core-descent-16-bit


Video montage by my daughter ❤



Game page: https://agateau.com/projects/pixelwheels/
